chunks.text: Welcome to the Slow English podcast.
In this podcast, we speak slow and easy English.
Today we talk about a beautiful historical city.
The city is Mostar.
Mostar is in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
It is a country in the Balkan region of Europe.
Mostar is famous for its old bridge, river, and Ottoman history.
Part two, the city is built around the Niretva River.
The river is very clear and blue.
People walk along the river and enjoy the beautiful views.
The water looks very refreshing in summer.
Part three, the most famous place in Mostar is the Old Bridge.
This bridge is called Starimost.
It was built many centuries ago during the Ottoman period.
Today it is a symbol of the city.
Part four, many visitors come to watch people jump from the bridge.
Some local people dive into the cold river below.
This is a famous tradition in Mostar.
It is exciting to watch.
Part five, the old town of Mostar is very charming.
There are stone streets, small shops, and old buildings.
Walking in the old town feels like traveling into the past.
Visitors enjoy exploring the area slowly.
Part six, Mostar has strong Ottoman influences.
You can see mosques, traditional houses, and Turkish style cafes.
The culture is a mix of east and west.
This makes the city very unique.
Part seven, food in Mostar is delicious and traditional.
One famous food is Cevapi.
Cevapi are small grilled meat pieces served with bread.
People also enjoy Burek and strong Bosnian coffee.
Part eight, the people in Mostar are friendly and welcoming.
Hospitality is important in the city.
Visitors often sit in cafes and talk with local people.
The atmosphere feels warm and relaxed.
Part nine, the weather in Mostar is warm in summer.
The city gets a lot of sunshine.
People spend time outside near the river and cafes.
Evenings are calm and beautiful.
Part 10,
Mostar also has a difficult history.
During the war in the 1990s, many buildings were damaged.
The old bridge was destroyed during the conflict.
Later the bridge was rebuilt again.
Part 11, today Mostar is peaceful and full of visitors.
People from many countries come to see its beauty and history.
The city remembers its past but also looks toward the future.
Tourism is important for the local economy.
